title: Define rules-pack source manifest and license metadata
description:
Define the metadata format used by rules-pack importers to record source title, source version, source URL or local source identity, license name, attribution text, source hash/date, allowed-use flags, and per-record provenance policy.

This should support both pack-level and record-level provenance.
acceptance_criteria:
- Manifest schema exists.
- Manifest supports source/license/provenance fields.
- Manifest supports attribution text.
- Manifest supports allowed-use flags needed by pack policy.
- Tests validate representative manifest examples.
close_reason: RulesPackSource and RecordProvenance shipped; validator + fixtures + tests updated.
